name: csls-vscode-tests
description: Drives the packaged csls extension through a real VS Code extension host.

scripts.check: npm run check:typescript && npm run check:javascript && npm run test:process-lifecycle
scripts.check:javascript: tsc --ignoreConfig --allowJs --checkJs false --noEmit --target ES2025 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node,vscode extension.cjs oracle-suite.cjs provision.mjs remote-controller.cjs remote-resolver/extension.cjs runner.mjs web-runner.mjs
scripts.compile:desktop: esbuild suite.ts --bundle --external:vscode --format=cjs --outfile=dist/suite.cjs --platform=node --target=node24 && esbuild startup-suite.ts --bundle --external:vscode --format=cjs --outfile=dist/startup-suite.cjs --platform=node --target=node24 && esbuild shutdown-suite.ts --bundle --external:vscode --format=cjs --outfile=dist/shutdown-suite.cjs --platform=node --target=node24
scripts.compile: npm run check && npm run compile:desktop && npm run compile:web
